policy: One-off assessment snapshot. Public customer context only; never evidence of a compliance violation. Reviewer identity and profile data intentionally removed.

reviews.text: Only played 3 holes before being rained out. Par 5, 3 and another 5 all of which played fair. Course plays fair from fairways and greens roll true but a little slow. Green speed influenced by grain.
Pace of play is horrendous. It’s 12:20 and we just finished hole 10 with a 9:20 tee time.

Very poor customer.service.
Course not worth $95 to play
The place has dramatically improved following the renovation. Excited to do my next family outing over here!

I found this course while in town for work with a quick "Golf near me" search lol, honestly it did not disappoint. The course itself was in decent enough shape for the price and location. The gentleman marshalling were actually kind which is a 180 to the normal Marshall's and I tried to do the scenery justice but my pictures don't compare. All in all worth the visit.
Wonderful course, they just opened the 9 and 18th greens after renovations

Beautiful course and a great place to play! The staff is always friendly and welcoming, and it’s clear the owner has done an outstanding job updating and maintaining the course. The conditions are excellent, and I especially love seeing the turtles, birds, and other wildlife around the ponds. It truly feels like a peaceful oasis in the middle of Atlanta. Highly recommend this course to anyone looking for a relaxing and enjoyable round of golf!

Updating my rating from two years ago. Almost 4-start worthy but still falls short.

Glows (where does it shine)
Great shape. Love the changes to 9 and 18. Beautiful layout. Greens are amazing

Grows (still needs improving)
Carts in by 8pm in the summer cheats people of an hour of daylight for after work golf
Range not always open
Need to add a walking 9hole rate for after work
Need a junior rate
Need to participate in youth on course
Golf carts do not have rain covers
No drinking water on course

Solid golf course, best starting hole in Atlanta public golf! Fairways and rough in great shape, greens just topdressed, but they are gonna be spectacular by the end of July!. Redone holes are open (9 & 18) and although they aren't great, its a significant improvement. Build of new clubhouse and entertainment facility can't happen fast enough.
Nice course, in great shape!!!

The golf is good. Well kept course, however it’s 95° and I haven’t seen a cart staff since hole 4. There’s no water filling stations available on the course. I’ve called the clubhouse 3 times now, no answer. I am extremely disappointed considering I payed $80 for green fees, I would expect some customer service. Other than that, very good track. Definitely would play again (of course I’ll have to bring my own case of waters).

Used to play this course quite a bit, and today came back for the first time in a few years. Course is in very good shape and the staff is awesome. Renovations to 9 and 18 are great and make for a more visually appealing finish to both nines. Played early and finished right at 4 hours. A huge improvement from the past. Lost my putter cover and the staff went above and beyond to try to help find it. Will be adding Wolf Creek back to the rotation.

No water
Temporary greens
High Price $80 bucks
Carts GPS don’t work
Beautiful course! Great customer service!

I really like this course, and normally I would get it five stars. However, I had friends drive an hour and 15 minutes to meet me there today, only to find out that there were two temporary greens and that they were just sanded last week. I’m leaving this review because I really feel like given the two times we called, we should’ve been informed about the situation BEFORE we got there.

Hate to say it but has to be said. Played this course for the first time but will never be back. Paid over $75 for a round and unfortunately had a very disappointing experience.

Our golf cart suddenly shut down during the round despite following all course rules and staying within the designated GPS boundaries. What made it even more frustrating was that two other groups experienced the exact same issue at the same time, suggesting this was not an isolated problem.

I was playing with elderly gentlemen, and after waiting an extended period for assistance that never arrived until the last hole, we were forced to push our carts manually from hole to hole just to continue the round. One member of our group had another commitment afterward, so waiting indefinitely was not an option.

When I spoke with management, I was told the issue was "Yamaha's problem" and not the course's responsibility. When I asked who I could speak with regarding the inconvenience and disruption to our round, I was essentially told "nobody" and that "it was what it is."

Equipment issues can happen anywhere. What disappointed me most was not the cart failure itself, all the ball from the range lating in the fairway at the first hole it's the lack of urgency, customer service, and accountability afterward. For a course charging premium rates, I expected a much better response.

I hope management reconsiders how situations like this are handled in the future.
Excellent customer service! Beautiful golf course! Greens and hills make it very challenging! I will return and recommend!

Hello family,  well where should I start.  If you are looking for a challenging course to play?  This one is it!! The Greens are exceptionally fast, this particular day the pins were set right on the edge of the slopes.  They also had a rise to them as if they were pulled up instead of turned and cut.
There is also some renovations going on which should have been revealed upon arrival.  With that being said, there should not have been a fee of almost $100.00....
Outside of that our league enjoyed a great day fellowshiping ...

I was really impressed with the conditions here. The staff clearly takes pride in the course—it’s very clean and well-maintained. The greens were very well maintained, which made for a fun challenge. On top of the playability, the views across the course are awesome. Highly recommend for any local or visiting golfers! One of the best courses in and around Atlanta.
Played it for the first time today. Great course. Challenging holes make it fun. Course is in great shape. The undulating Greens have a great roll to them. Will definitely be back.

WE LOVE PLAYING THIS COURSE! 80 is a little steep for 16 holes as Right now the 9th and 19th hole is getting re built to have a real pro finish on a 9 hole round or an 18 hole round!
I believe it will be a very exciting new finish for this course! I can’t wait to see the results!
Just hit the range but course looks great. Very nice and affordable range balls. Great service
Great time wonderful golf course

Honestly a great course but it’s been a couple months of the course having 9 & 18 on temporary greens that don’t give you the full experience you pay for. No advance warning on the website nor in the clubhouse until after you’ve paid what you usually pay to play 18. At least give me a bag of range balls for the inconvenience — anticipating this sort of frustration is so easy. I’ll be back when it’s all 18
Great course
2 temporary fairway greens that were not disclosed prior to booking.
Course is great. But this customer service is lacking. Imagine submitting multiple requests for Membership information and getting no response

Full prices for two greens in the middle of the fairway that are unputtable, and turn 9 and 18 into 180 yd non par 3 holes. Wasn’t disclosed at all until payment was processed in the pro shop and offered 10% off next time for some “light remodeling”. There won’t be a next time. Disclosure and discounted rates should have happened before taking people’s money to play a course under major reconstruction.

This was my 1st time playing here. I am so glad that I did. Beautiful course. Love the layout. Challenging but not impossible to play. Staff were helpful, friendly, and attentive. Special shout out to Cliff! He’s the man. I will definitely put this course on must play when I’m in town.

Decent course and layout during warm months, but overpriced for winter conditions. 2 temporary greens which weren’t disclosed when booking and also were not puttable. Also wide open tee sheet. Bringing winter price down would likely bring in more revenue for the course

Staff is great. Layout of course is great. However, no Marshall, no starter. Two groups of 5 in front of us? No water anywhere on course? Only saw cart girl once in 5.5 hour round (super slow pace). Greens are like cement, WAY too fast, plus they place almost every pin on a slope. I just played Pinehurst #2. Putting was easier at Pinehurst. They need to let their greens grow a little. There’s no grain or grab. It’s kind of ridiculous.

I stumbled across this course while trying to squeeze in a round on the south side of Atlanta before flying out the next day, and honestly, I was pleasantly surprised by what I got for the price.

It’s a solid, challenging 18 with plenty of tee boxes, which worked out great for me and my wife. Even after a couple days of rain, the conditions held up really well.

The scenery was a standout: everything from wide-open fields to swampy stretches to wooded holes. It felt like you were getting a little bit of everything in one course.

I’m already looking forward to my next trip to the Atlanta area, and I’ll absolutely carve out time to play here again.

Came here after I checked out of my hotel as I had some hours before my flight. I was impressed with the hospitality, the pace of play, the value for the money, the rolling hills and elevation changes. I’m from Toronto, the grass was some of the trickiest rough to play out of, the course is long, challenging, and well maintained. The staff kept my luggage safe and secure as I came in an uber. Even as a local, I can’t see why you wouldn’t give this course a try. If you’re visiting I’d definitely make this course the last destination, not just for airport proximity. Only room for improvement would be to have a cart girl on course, and I wish there was a shower on the premises before I flew out but I know not all courses have that. Still a great experience and will return next time I’m in the A.

My friends and I feel this course is in great shape and it’s conveniently located.  However my most recent experience was bad!   The marshals turned a fun evening of golf into a bad experience.  First, on the 2nd hole, a marshal rudely rushed us and demanded to see our receipts.   Which of course we shared with him.  Later in the round we skipped a few holes since the group ahead of us was very slow.  A marshal appeared and said he’d been following us and we can’t do that!  We shared that it was getting dark and we were only playing 2 more holes.   He argued with us about that until the other Marshal told him we had already agreed on that with him.  It started as a good day of golf, but was unnecessarily turned into a bad experience.
Good course nice greens

I recently had my first time playing this course, and I was thoroughly impressed with the fairways and greens. Since I didn’t have room for my own clubs while traveling, I had to rent some. Fortunately, the rental clubs were in excellent condition. Cliff, the staff member, was incredibly helpful and friendly. Overall, I highly recommend this course.
Fun course

Update: Played 9.30.2025:  Course is magnificent.  Tee box maintenance and replacement is almost complete and, where complete, is really well done.  They've also cleared some overgrowth around greens and fairways to clean up some narrow lines - really improved the course.  Lastly, the new changes on 6 are underway (IYKYK) so this is going to be a huge improvement.

Played here about 6 times since late spring. Mostly early AM or on weekdays, so haven’t run into pace of play issues as the course either isn’t crowded (weekdays) or I’m one of the first people teeing off.

Yes, on-course amenities are limited. Bring your own water but that’s par for the course on all the municipal and privately-owned/public courses in ATL metro.  They do run a beverage cart (I think just Friday and weekends although not certain about Friday).

Yes, range hours can be a tad spotty. It’s largely dependent on weather. The course is river bottom so holds water after a rain. Heavy rain the night before- range closed.  They have a great putting green AND have a new plan for the range so look for improvement.

With all that said, the course is phenomenal. Greens are in great shape and run a bit fast.  Fairways are very well managed with a nice clean first cut rough and a long second cut rough.  Most tee boxes are in great shape, except where they’ve been heavily shaded and for most of those they are working on some form of mitigation plan.  This is absolutely one of my favorite courses in the metro area and I’m going to continue to visit as often as I have time.

I have one small criticism about course routing in that it starts with a par five followed by a three followed by a five. It then ends on two par fives. That’s a pretty minor thing and has more to do with my preference for course routing so not a major issue. If you enjoy course aesthetics, this has a really lovely central pond and creek area where lots of holes start or terminate. It’s an absolutely gorgeous view on a nice day.

I’ve always found the staff to be friendly both at the front desk and when they’re running a cart beverage on the course.

In terms of pricing, I agree it seems a little expensive on the weekend but is much more affordable during the week. However, labor cost are extraordinarily high for golf courses, and I can’t imagine that they have much of a choice in the way they price. Frankly, it’s not that much more expensive than DeKalb or Atlanta municipal courses.
Beautiful course, we were in town on a work trip. Absolutely loved our time. Very accommodating team.

Beautiful, well-maintained course. Great variety of hole lengths (Par 5, Par 3, etc.) the staff is very friendly - Cliff was super helpful and made sure we were taken care of and enjoying ourselves. Highly recommend Wolf Creek!

Wolf Mountain has a really great selection of wines. We really enjoyed our time there. The flatbreads were so tasty and fresh and the view was serene. Only reason it lost a star was the website mentioned tours but we learned that they cancelled tours once we got to the vineyard and because the artisan cheese board was very very small but it does taste really great.
Overcharged for a round, price was almost double what was online. Not a single water station in the entire course/establishment. Exactly what you’d expect from this environment

Great experience! from Houston and was there for the Astros game this past weekend. The course is doing some maintenance, but it’s still great! just a little challenging for a newbie like me! Definitely recommend it!
I have come to the Atlanta area from Ohio. Five stars due to the customer service from Cliff. Great guy at the counter. Course was in good shape, greens were good. Definitely happy I played here.
Greens were kept well and the whole course was fantastic

What a beautiful course! We had a large group of 12 walk in the door with multiple rentals and were taken care of excellently. Cliff and his staff were great to work with and despite how chaotic everything was, they got us out on the course in no time. Will look forward to playing at Wolf Creek in the future!

I hadn't played this course in a few years, and it's undergone a signficant transformation. They've clearly put a lot of work into the course and it's in excellent shape. Greens, fairways, and rough all in great condition. Staff is friendly and accomodating. Played 18 on a Tuesday in under 3.5 hours. Will be back soon.

This is a hidden gem! They are putting a lot of money into the course and every time I play it it gets better. Even the food service has improved.  The cart girls have been showing up more frequent and appear to more knowledgeable of course etiquette than before. I play here almost every week and I love it. Great course and great price!

This course is beautiful but management is lowkey trash. Came out here on a Sunday, they have no range balls, were told, “they’re picking them now, but have no ETA”. They charge like $70-80 for 18 holes, there are no water refill depots on the course, they don’t have a chipping green, they don’t have anywhere to clean clubs after rounds, so my question is, why are yall charging folks so much? 🤣🤣🤣🤣 this is a $40 course, if that.

Enjoyed the round of golf at Wolf Creek. Amenities are okay, however they are improving.
Greens and fairways are in great condition.  Rough is ROUGH!! Keep it in fairway!!!!
Had early tee time so pace of play was no problem. Coming back in fall.

Great golf course for my game (wide and forgiving) and getting better. Throughly enjoy this course. Rebuilding a couple of Par 3s and cutting down some trees. Very scenic. Seems as if the new owners are investing a lot into the course. Reasonably priced and highly recommended.

Got early tee time. Their internet was down however staff was friendly and professional considering the situation. Pace of play was great. Greens and fairways on great condition. 11 tee box is being upgraded other than that.. great golf facility. Keep improving Wolf Creek!!!
Fun and challenging course. It’s in great shape with a very friendly staff.
Great course fairways in amazing shape greens were nice. Faculty were nice and hospitable.

Solid course with good tee boxes. Challenging holes and pin locations.  Would play again if the price comes down as it’s not worth $70 on a Friday. Dynamic pricing based on the day of the week. Needs to go back to the $50-55 range. Used to give a free bottle of water before the round, not anymore. No water jugs on the course. Ran out of hot dogs for the day at 11:40
Nice course and service

Absolutely beautiful course. Fairways are in perfect condition. The first cut can be tricky if you’re not used to the grass. Greens are challenging, which makes it even more fun.
The staff is very friendly and courteous.

If you enjoy 5.5-hour rounds of golf behind groups of 25-handicappers with zero course etiquette, this might be the place for you. Expect to see players wandering into the driving range from hole 1 looking for their ball, and absolutely no enforcement of pace-of-play standards.

Strangely, despite the total lack of course management in that regard, the staff seemed far more concerned about my 3-year-old riding along in the cart “for liability reasons.” Instead of offering a waiver to allow a parent to enjoy a round of golf with their child, they made it clear this wasn’t acceptable.

For reference, I regularly play in under 3 hours—even with my toddler—because I understand the flow of the game and bring my brother to help. But here, you’ll spend more time waiting on tee boxes than hitting shots, watching the group ahead chunk it 30 yards at a time.

It’s frustrating to see such backwards priorities at a course that clearly caters to casual or beginner players but won’t accommodate a parent sharing the game with their kid. I won’t be coming back—kid or no kid.
This is a great course. Cliff is an awesome guy. The greens were in great shape. I’ll definitely be back!
A beautiful golf course just outside of Atlanta
Awesome track. One of the best public courses in the Atlanta area. Great grass, nice staff, and challenging yet fun holes.
In good shape. Poor etiquette from some players.

One of the best public golf facilities in metro Atlanta. The course features compelling and high-quality green complexes, a fun and thoughtful routing, and a layout that’s both challenging and rewarding. Conditioning is consistently excellent, and the setting is beautiful from start to finish. With the improvements being made under new ownership this is a course I’ll continue to recommend and play without hesitation.

H O F Calvin Johnson
Here Today

& Greens

For the Detroit Lions.

MEGATRON GETTIN it.
Another course with music what a joke
Stay away. Not the same place it was years ago. The cart paths are a wreck. They don’t sell beer or allow you to bring it. Staff is very rude. It’s a travesty because this course use to be top notch

Kicked us off 18 at 6:45 because they had to get the cart boys home at a “decent” hour. (Sun doesn’t go down until 8:30) Pace of play was horrible and the Marshalls driving around the entire time didn’t do or say anything about it. Didnt know when I paid for 18 holes I was paying to play until the cart boys wanted to leave. Terrible customer service.
Great course layout. Challenging but rewarding. PGA type greens & picturesque surroundings.  Driving range, putting greens, & a great friendly staff, eager to assist...

Worst golf experience, the pace of play is horrible, the marshals drive around the course and do nothing, they stack tee times on top of each other. We showed up with no carts ready, was late to the tee time because of not having a cart. 6 hours of my life wasted on this course. To pay 70 dollars for this experience is truly disappointing. Wish I could have my money back.

This is the worst pace of play I have ever seen. The Marshalls do not care, we showed up and they didn’t have any carts ready. Didn’t tee off till 20 minutes past tee time. The worst management I’ve ever seen. Currently playing a 6 hour round
Had an awesome time.  will play again

Duratec Roofing Solutions came by for a work event and we had an amazing time! Great course and even greater people!! Clarise at the front desk was amazing as well as Shabazz, and Jabari. All three were 5-star in not only hospitality, but in helping us get organized on and off the course! Excited for our next trip back to Wolf Creek Golf Club!!!

Disappointed in my experience here.  Customer service was lacking and being more rude towards an issue i was willing to resolve. Hidden fees were not disclosed during booking process. The lack of transparency was frustrating and left a bad impression. The screens for the cart to alert the staff of an issue does not work and they expect you to resolve the issue on your own. Additionally instead of being on-coming and direct the manager ignored the problem.

Cart shut off on six and i was in need of a cart due to injury. Waiting nobody came with an extra cart. Manager didn’t want to resolve the issue with the Cart and says he actually shut the cart down way before closing. Instead of coming to address the problem with the cart he just shut it off. After walking the 3 mile stretch back the manager began to be hostile. Poor customer service and poor  problem solving skills.

The course is in great condition for being so early in the season. They have really opened up the course by removing some pesky trees and shrubs.

My new iPhone fell out of the cart and a Ranger tracked me down to return it. All the staff were very helpful and kind.

Golf course was laid out well with interesting and challenging holes. Not in the best condition when we played. Staff very helpful and polite but the facilities let it down. No bar or restaurant, you could get snacks and coffee. No pro shop to speak of ( forget my pitch repairer couldn't buy one !!)
But for the money excellent value... Play here it's great
This course is going to be amazing once it's completed.  They are redoing some holes and building a clubhouse.  The new sand traps are beautiful. I will definitely be going back once it's completed.
8 some in front of us.  Called course and they did nothing.
Great course
Very nice course layout was interesting. Staff was very helpful
Best golf for the price.
Live in Florida but love playing this course when we’re in town: it’s in great shape. Staff is friendly and helpful.

Some of the course conditioning could be a bit better. Wish there were walking rates as I paid the same amount walking as the rider rate but whatever I'm not a brokey! This was my first time playing so the young man at the starter asked if I REALLY wanted to walk. Good Lord some of the green to tee walks were kinda long and the elevation changes were striking at points. Also there were some holes where you had to walk in total opposite directions because they didn't have bridges to walk straight to the next fairway over the ravines. However the trek was not as bad as other mountain courses I have walked. Still staid in front of the guys who let me through on the first box and kept about a 5 hole cushion. Greens ran true and for a public track, they were pretty well above average. If they had a membership I would contemplate it but it would be a tough sale for me because outside of member guest I don't use carts smh. All in all, I paid 42 bucks on a Wednesday when I think it should be priced at around 28-32 bucks but they are gonna get whatever they want with it being a historic affluent African American neighborhood.

By far the worst customer service I’ve ever experienced on a golf course. They don’t care about customer experience at all. Only about going home early. This place is a joke and will not ever receive another penny of my hard earned money.
It was my pleasure to support my Friend of Longstanding and the South West Highschool Alumnus Association.
This course was definitely fun to play,  but for 70 dollars, it lacked some basic amenities. Will play again in the future.
$45 course for the price of $75. Bare bones amenities. Very expensive concessions. $4+ for a Powerade. Interesting course, but better value out there in the Atlanta area.

Great course .... greens in great shape .... staff friendly and helpful..... no cart service as a heads up but left the cart with comp water on it at the turn and comp water to start .... hard to beat!
This is the 1st time in a very long time I played Wolf Creek and was very surprised how well manicured the course was, really enjoyed playing it again.
Very good condition

Decent course with tons of potential. The staff was great aside from one woman behind the counter who tried to say we dented the rental club driver which was dented long before we rented them.

The course itself is beautiful over rolling hills with lots of variety. My only complaint would be how the tee boxes are marked and maintained. The color markers should be placed on top of the tee box, not buried on the far side no one can see from the cart. It’s the only course I’ve been to where I couldn’t find the tee boxes on numerous holes.

Ps - get better rental clubs, cart service, and clubhouse selections.

What an experience! Truly one of the best managed public courses in the southeast. If you ever need help, just ask for Cliff or Deborah… some top notch service and a pure course. Been playing this course for 10
Years and it’s under the best management I’ve seen so far. Kudos to Wolf Creek Golf
Course is coming in and looking great
Had a large group  (32 guys) today and was charged $74. Greens were absolutely horrible condition. SHAMEFUL
Above average course. The greens were aerated recently but still "puttable". The fairways are nice, layout is challenging. I'd go back - even with the greens being punched.

Had a great time playing the course today.  Very fun late out with a good mix of holes.  Greens very recently aerated but course overall looking in great shape.  Very nice golf carts with GPS as well.  Looking forward to playing again here soon
It’s a fun and challenging course, but we spent half the time driving the cart in reverse because the geofence is messed up even on the cart paths.

A very good golf course! I remember when it opened I have played it for the last 24 years. I’ve watched it go up and down. It’s on the upswing. I am looking forward to investing in the clubhouse having a snack menu a stronger breakfast-lunch…

The greens are in very good shape. A few rough spots here were there, but for the most part, the value in the course are really, really good. I recommend you play this course and have fun. The golf carts are going to be nice. It is challenging, but I really do believe it’s going to be rewarding as welll!

Was looking forward to playing here again but found out they won't let you play 18 holes after 1pm... they won't even let you try to play 18 holes.  I will definitely be taking my business to courses that at least let you play until it gets dark.  Such a disappointment for a course that has potential, but not the commitment to players trying to play in the winter when days are short and extremely limited.... terrible management and terrible publicity for your course that isn't as known or popular as others in the area.  Good luck to you because I don't see a bright future if this is how you do business.

Have been playing Wolf Creek off and on for at least 5 or 6 years. As others noted, there was a definitely a period between ownership changes where the course got in pretty bad shape. I went back in December 2023 and found the course to be very good shape for winter conditions and the greens probably in the best condition I've seen there. Worth a vist and convenient to intown Atlanta.

The course appears to be under renovation as the tees were way up and the white and red tees were at the same spot. Most of the greens had a fungus and it looks like they will lose a number of greens. They already have one temporary green.  The pace of play was good and the fairways and rough were decent.  If they can fix the greens it would be a 5.

I played on 10/31/23 and the course has been renovated.  The greens were in great shape and the course is fun to play. I would recommend that players put this course back on their list.  We played 18 in 3 hours which is another bonus.

My husband and I really enjoy this course and the staff is also super friendly. My only reservation to a 5 star review for this lovely public course is that there are multiple holes that do not have a proper tee box for the ladies. They’ve just put red markers down somewhere in front of the white tee boxes - and in most cases these ladies “tees” are on an incline and with untrimmed Bermuda grass. In those cases, I end up playing the whites w my husband.
Beautiful place
First time visit to the club. Beautiful fairways and greens. Updated golf carts, friendly staff, but my favorite was meeting the golf marshal Kevin! 🤩🤩
Great course at an even better price. I’ll be back.

Played there August 15th. Course was well maintained, in fact as we played some holes were being serviced. Golf carts are out of this world!! Maps and distance were on the screen in the cart. Only draw back is,  if you're new to the course,  the cart will stop if you are in a restricted area in the fairway.
Most importantly was the great customer service at the front desk! Denise was very welcoming to us.  I left a putter cover on one of the holes, left my info for her to call me if returned, and she did.  And I believe she stayed a few minutes past her shift to do so. Overall great experience there. Can't wait to play there again.
Great shape! Decent price

Played golf today, 8/2/2023, at Wolf Creek Golf Club. Club representative, Denise greeted us with a pleasant conversation and great service.  The course was in excellent shape! We had a wonderful time, and we are planning to schedule another round of play in the very near future.

This was our first time coming to this golf course. Stopped here on our way back home to Arkansas and we are glad we did. We really did enjoy it. Everyone was very friendly and very professional. Also, the greens are nicely taken care of and the golf carts are excellent with great features. A huge thank you to Cliff and Kaylee (hope I spelled that right) for helping us get our sunglasses back to us. We accidentally left them in the golf cart.

I just played a round of golf at the much improved Wolf Creek Golf course. The greens are in great condition!  I was warmly greeted by Denise and she updated me on the carts and course improvements. I have always enjoyed the customer service from Denise, but the greens had deteriorated and we stayed away from Wolf Creek for months. It was a good golf outing. Note, the prices have changed since my last visit.
Challenging course! Nice open fairways well-maintained greens.  Need clubhouse and larger pro shop. Affordable.
Very nice course! Good shape after this winter. Play moves nicely!
It's a simple long-range course with good price. I liked it because there are not many options for a public course that have more than 3 holes of par 5s. They should work on the signs, though.

This is my home course. I’ve been coming since the days of the clubhouse trailer. It’s been a tough past 12 months. The new greens are in and starting to get seasoned. They are definitely fast. Denise runs the clubhouse with style and grace. We are grateful for her and the rest of the team. I see things that need improvement. I’m giving it a chance before I pass judgement. Nonetheless, my group is out there 2-3 times a week. We will see what the summer brings….

Course at one time was one of the best in the city, but over the last year has become one of the worst, especially for its price. Some greens are unplayable and fairways are terrible. Should be called Dog Creek unsteady of Wolf creek!

On 4/23/23, Me and my fellow golfer (Mr. Barnes) booked at T Time @ WC around 4:15PM. Mr. Barnes showed up as I was on the range chatting with friends. When I entered the reception area, Mr. Barnes and the customer service rep (Denise) was discussing WC pricing. As Mr. Barnes inquired about pricing, Denise was getting more hostile, and angry. I also asked a question regarding WC pricing because on 4/22/23, we played at WC with a T Time around 4:15PM. I was charged $63.57 which I thought was too much according to the time. According to Denise I was charged correctly. On 4/23/23 around 8:00AM, I called WC to speak to the manager regarding the charge. I spoke to a gentleman @ WC regarding the charge. And he stated he would let the manager know. I left my number and as of today, I still haven't heard from the manager of WC.

First the good. The course was green, had nice elevation changes and they had cold drinks in the clubhouse. That's about it.
The bad. After completing my round which was wrought with frustration at the lack of any yardage indicators beyond the tee box, and no functioning GPS units in the carts, I returned to the parking lot to discover that my truck window had been smashed and articles stolen from my vehicle. The staff called the police for me and I did my best to calmly wait for them. Upon arrival I learned from officer that this happens 5 TO 6 TIMES A WEEK THERE!!! Let me repeat that again. IT HAPPENS NEARLY ONCE A DAY!!!! I am at a loss to understand how a place which has half a dozen or more security cameras around the (small) parking lot and hired a "marshal" to patrol the lot has this happen. The "marshal" said that what happened to my truck must have happened while he was on lunch. *reckless speculation disclaimer waiver *  I have to wonder if the staff isn't in on this. How can they hire someone to watch the parking lot, have multiple security cameras pointed at the grounds an this happen multiple times per week. Another questionable point is that I learned that management hasn't turned the video from several of these recent thefts over to the police. Now again I have no proof of this at all. This is just my logical mind putting 2 and 2 together and getting 4. FYI this occurred between 2:00 and 4:30 pm on a Saturday.  If you know you have a problem with vehicles being broken into why not have adequate staff to watch the parking lot. At $74.00 for 18 holes I think they could afford to hire someone.
So I won't be back. If you do go for the golf I hope you bring a rangefinder and take adequate precautions to hide all your valuables out of sight and certainly lock your car.

UPDATE:  So after a week on the phone, a dozen phone calls and the "this isn't in my control you need to speak with XXX" runaround, it appears that the video evidence (which exists and I was told shows the break in and the theft along with the car they drove away in) wasn't and won't be sent to the police. I don't understand that. Why wouldn't they send it? Corporate says that is up to the local club. The local club says corporate has to do it. Regardless I know there was a 0% chance that I ever get any satisfaction on this, but I am disappointed in the people I had to deal with here.

My car and a friend’s car were recently broken into in the parking lot of Atlanta Wolf Creek golf course. The thieves broke into both of our gloveboxes stealing my friend’s checkbook and my gun.

Because the course is not in the best part of town we intentionally parked near the “security camera” that clearly stated that there is video surveillance on property. When we went to the front desk to ask about the camera footage, he informed us that the camera was fake, that this has been going on for two months and that we parked in the spot where cars are getting broken into.

Two months, eight people robbed before us. There were no signs in the lot to warn their customers not to leave items in their car or that break-ins were occurring. No action to put in a working camera to help counteract this type of activity.

I called Warrior Asset Management, the company that owns Wolf Creek, and they told me I should just call my insurance to handle my loss and I should have been more careful knowing that I was playing golf in a high crime area. The thieves are now armed with a stolen gun. Wolf Creek is off my list of courses to play in Atlanta Georgia.
